rows.grounds: fused form kartavyam + anyat + ca with internal sandhi

items.question: What activities are prohibited on the fourteenth lunar day?
items.inference: On caturdaśī, neither other work nor auspicious work should be undertaken.
uncertainties: exact scope of 'other' work is unspecified
verse gives a prescriptive calendar rule
items.plain_english: On the fourteenth day, nothing else should be done, nor any auspicious work.
